title: Muscle Wasting

positions.as_written: Measure the circumference of both thighs at the same distance above the joint line, using the patella's upper border as the landmark, and record the distance used.
Ask the patient to tighten the quadriceps and watch both sides, because wasting is clearer with the muscle contracting.
An effusion inhibits the quadriceps directly, so wasting in a chronically effused knee has a cause that must be addressed before the muscle can be rebuilt.
